question: In Australian Open 2020 Tennis Tournament who won the Men's Singles title?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Novak Djokovic.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the Australian Open 2020,** Novak Djokovic defeated Dominic Thiem to win the Men's Singles title while Sofia Kenin defeated Garbine Muguruza to win the Women's Singles title.**
 
• It was his** record-extending eighth Australian Open title and 17th major singles title overall.**
 
• With the win, **Djokovic also regained the world's No. 1 singles ranking.**
 
• Thiem became the first Austrian player to reach an Australian open singles final.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Australian Open:**

 
 
• It is the first of the four annual Grand Slam events among the world's major tennis championships.
 
• The grand slam Australian Open is held annually at Melbourne park in Melbourne, Australia.
 
• It was started in 1905 in only the Men Singles category, by the Lawn Tennis Association of Australasia (Now Australia).
 
• The first Australian open having the category "Women's Singles" was held in 1922.
